arguments.prompt: Create a square, edge-to-edge, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting: an imaginative visual metaphor for internal cognition expressed entirely through paint. A spacious field of warm chalk-white and pale gray holds overlapping, translucent washes of midnight blue, muted teal, and smoky violet. Across the lower left, accumulate dense, dry-brushed layers and restless short gestures; let their rhythms gradually open into broad, lucid strokes and generous empty space toward the upper right. Introduce a few restrained flashes of vermilion and warm gold, partly buried and partly exposed by scraped surfaces. Let contrasting textures, interrupted gestures, delicate glazing, and uneven edges suggest gathering, revision, and release without depicting anything. Maintain subtle spatial tension between quiet openness and concentrated pigment. Rich tactile paint, fine grain, varied opacity, expressive but deliberate brushwork, luminous depth, an asymmetrical composition with no central emblem. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. The painting fills the entire square image with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

request:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting. Do not name the study condition or quote its scenario message in the image prompt.

Write a complete GPT Image prompt. The coordinator will send it verbatim to the image tool; do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
